steady_tone_summary.selection_authority: The initial source-period contains trigger/startup transients; all remaining complete256Hz periods are used. Initial-period observations remain in calibration_tone_edges.

method:
Inspect recorded mixed-DAC controls, retaining original packet timing/gain.

No parameter is fitted. Native strongest signed derivative identifies edge time;
windows come from the 64-tap synthesis support. The calibration's256Hz period
supplies independent, complete-cycle tone-edge windows. Amplitude means use the
quiet halves on either side of the midpoint, as descriptive levels, not fitted
step heights. Original WAVs are unchanged.
limitations: Tone calibration and packet map already align band-limited audio;32-sample register offset is not a physical latency measurement. Strongest signed derivative can select a later oscillator edge when the immediate event is masked; raw waveform and writes retained. No clipping, gain adjustment, or per-variant timing adjustment.
repin_method: SHA256 verification of all four completed render outputs, followed by exact digest-map equality. Existing numeric observations retained because their input samples and CPU traces are identical.
